Name: Watering Can Give Exp
Author: Achtuur8
Description:
[b][size=5]Overview
[/size][/b]
In the Stardew Valley, gaining farming experience early on is based entirely on harvesting crops, even though most of your time is spent watering. This mod aims to change that, watering crops now gives a small amount of exp. In order to balance the total exp, harvesting exp gains are reduced to 75% (this can be disabled).


[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16827]AchtuurCore[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.
[/list]
